name: Omi Oh My AI
storyline: Omi Oh My AI is about the titular character Omi, an artificial intelligence that has generated the puzzles in the game. Omi is a bit quirky, often asking the player to solve puzzles that are unclear or follow a line of logic that makes sense to Omi but requires the player to learn more about them. Only by discovering what it was that led to Omi's creation can you help this friendly AI to move on from the ghosts of their past and figure out their place in the world.
summary: Go on a captchavating adventure with Omi, a friendly (if a bit quirky) artificial intelligence! Learn to see the world the way Omi does as you solve image, word, and number puzzles inspired by the CAPTCHAs we’ve all had to do to prove we’re not a robot. Go outside the game and explore websites chronicling Omi’s development and learn how to solve the game’s stranger puzzles in this game inspired by AI, I Love Bees, the 90’s, and the constant need to prove you’re not a robot.
